definition.description: REV | Local Authority Register | Watch (wbs:4.6, CO-004, ADR-002-R2). WATCHES ONLY, never harvests — monthly edition-marker check, prompts a re-run on a mismatch. See notes.md.

metadata.description: Environment variable. The single recipient of the re-run prompt and the failure alert (C-TECH-047), same variable every other Teams-posting flow in this solution reads.

Once_a_month.description: Monthly, not quarterly (resolves OQ-202, see notes.md) — converges on ONSPD's own non-calendar-aligned publication cadence within a month, at the cost of one tiny request.

Initialise_failure_detail.description: Same pattern as REV | Scoring | Daily Summary — declared at the TOP level so the scope that fails is skipped from the failure onward and nothing inside it can carry a value out.

Get_ONSPD_edition_marker.description: GET of the ONSPD layer root, same URL the harvester reads. A-LAR-06: URL not live-reconfirmed. A-LAR-07: this Http action's own shape is doc-verified only — see notes.md.

Get_the_registers_own_last_known_edition.description: rev_setting row LocalAuthorityRegisterSourceEdition, written by the harvester on its last run. Absent means never harvested here — treated as a mismatch below (FR-205 fail-safe).

Compute_source_moved.description: True when the register has never recorded an edition, OR the live marker disagrees with what it recorded. Both are FR-205's 'do not assume current' case.

Notify_re_run_needed.description: 1:1 chat only (ADR-015, same as every Teams post in this solution). This is a prompt to act, not a failure — the register is stale, not broken, and nothing here is an error (S5.2 step 4/5).

parameters.body/messageBody:
Local authority register may be out of date

ONS has republished the postcode source, or the register has never been generated in this environment. Please re-run provisioning/dataverse/seed-local-authority-register.ps1 for this environment when convenient.

This is a routine prompt, not a failure - the previous register stays in force until the harvester next runs (wbs:4.6, CO-004).

Find_the_failed_action.description: Same pattern as REV | Scoring | Daily Summary — the FIRST child of the failed scope whose status is Failed, not result(scope)[0]'s generic wrapper.

Describe_the_failure.description: When the failed child is the nested Source_moved_or_never_harvested If, descend into it for the real message (same IMP-0109 shape as Read_configuration elsewhere). Otherwise the outer child IS the leaf.

Find_the_failed_step_inside_Source_moved.description: Only evaluated when Source_moved_or_never_harvested is the failure, so result() on it is safe.

Set_failure_detail_from_the_nested_condi.description: The leaf action inside the nested If — the one with the real message.

inputs.name: failureDetail
inputs.value: @{concat('Action: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_step_inside_Source_moved_or_never_harvested'))?['name'], 'unknown'), ' | Code: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_step_inside_Source_moved_or_never_harvested'))?['error']?['code'], 'none'), ' | Reason: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_step_inside_Source_moved_or_never_harvested'))?['error']?['message'], 'no message supplied by the platform'))}

Set_failure_detail.description: The failed child was not the nested If, so it is already the leaf.

inputs.name: failureDetail
inputs.value: @{concat('Action: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_action'))?['name'], 'unknown'), ' | Code: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_action'))?['error']?['code'], 'none'), ' | Reason: ', coalesce(first(body('Find_the_failed_action'))?['error']?['message'], 'no message supplied by the platform'))}

Alert_on_failure.description: Severity Warning: a failed CHECK loses observability of staleness for a month but corrupts nothing and blocks no application (NFR-201's own failure branch, S5.2 step 6).
